context.objective: Document how we carry out Expense Processing: T&E Review & Scrubbing (AEA Variant), the controls and what needs confirmation.

turns.text: AEA Concur expense reports become ready for review.
Talk me through what you do once an AEA Concur expense report is ready for review.
First the reviewer adds the report to the Excel review tracker.
What does the reviewer do with the report after adding it to the tracker?
Cardholder, statement total, submitted amount, report identifier, and status.
What does the reviewer compare those report details against?
Receipts and personal-expense classification on each line, then the approvals.
What does the reviewer verify about the approvals?
The current AEA rulebook; the receipt threshold is not confirmed yet.
What does the reviewer check in the approval trail against the AEA rulebook?
Approvers and statuses in Concur, then screenshots them and saves the report PDF.
What happens to a report when the reviewer finds an issue?
Flags it to the submitter or client and records the resolution in the tracker.
Once an issue is resolved, how does the reviewer know the report is ready to continue?
It stays out of the scrubbing batch; only cleared reports go in.
What does the reviewer do to scrub reports once they enter the batch?
This capture still has open sections. 15 of 16 are open; the Notes list shows which. You can create a partial draft.
